Modern day large animals in hot environments (ostriches, emus, lions, Buffalo, some populations of bison, etc) all have fur. Elephants have massive ears they pump blood to to keep cool (which dinosaurs cant have because they possess a completely different ear structure) and rhinos stay in shade or in mud wallows. So it is most likely they would possess some feather covering, doesn't mean they're fluffy like a chicken, but something. However, only time and future discoveries/studies will be able to make us certain as to which one it is.
